rename.from: Dependency parity validator complains about dependencies present in a dependency
rename.to: Dependency parity validator is missing dependencies with different versions

issue.title: Dependency parity validator is missing dependencies with different versions

labels.name: area/devtools
labels.description: Issues/PR related to maven, gradle, platform and cli tooling/plugins

issue.body:
Fix #10279 

@aloubyansky the idea is to disregard versions when comparing expected with actual.

issue.title: [Quarkus 1.6.0] Remove our dependency parity check once quarkusio/quarkus#10279 is fixed
issue.body: The code assembling `parityViolations` can be removed from tooling/scripts/validate-dependencies.groovy once the fixes https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/10286 and https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/10307 for quarkusio/quarkus#10279 reach us. The PRs are merged, but are not part of 1.6.0.CR1
